name: D. T. Bramble
role: Black Hills freight forwarder, of Keyes & Bramble
bio: D. T. Bramble was a freight forwarder in the firm of Keyes & Bramble, which in March 1884 was reported to have contracted for its Black Hills freight to be delivered only at Dickinson. That spring the firm set up an office at Medora, where Bramble oversaw loading of Hills freight. In July 1884 the Cow Boy's 'Vale, Bramble!' accused him of acting in an unprincipled manner toward the Hills merchants and of steering contracts through Dickinson, and the paper cheered his departure. By September 1884 he was stocking groceries in a new store north of the depot.
